cameraRoll.q: Is this replacing my camera roll?
cameraRoll.a: No. The album is where everyone drops the night so everyone can grab what they want. The keepers go into your own gallery. It is not meant to be your main photo storage.

join.a: You send an invite link or show a QR code. They join on iOS or Android and the photos are there. Only people you invite can see the album, not the rest of the internet.

others.q: Aren't there other apps for this?
others.a: Yes, and we're not pretending otherwise. The iPhone does it too, if everyone in the room has one. We're cloud-first and work on Android, so nobody gets left out of the album.

story.q: Does the Instagram story have your logo on it?
story.a: No. It just has a look. If people recognize it, great. If they don't, it's still a decent story.
